entities.summary: Adam Krupski was a professor of philosophy and Jesuit priest in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Legal expert in the legislation of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, author of a school dialogue. His handwritten lectures on philosophy have survived. In his teaching activities, he adhered to the ideas of the Enlightenment.
